def.micro: your money kept by a bank
def.short: a service where a bank keeps your money for you
def.long: A service where a bank keeps your money for you. You can put money in, take it out and pay for things with your card.

examples.en: I want to open a bank account.
examples.tr: Bir banka hesabı açmak istiyorum.

examples.en: I'll send the money to your bank account tonight.
examples.tr: Parayı bu akşam banka hesabına gönderirim.

examples.en: Deniz needs her passport to open a bank account here.
examples.tr: Deniz'in burada banka hesabı açmak için pasaportuna ihtiyacı var.

tr.note: Kısaca 'account' da denir: 'I have an account at this bank.' Hesap numarasına 'account number' denir.

quiz.cloze: I want to keep my money safe, so I'm going to open a ______.

entries.sense_note: take money out of a bank

def.micro: take money out of a bank
def.short: take money out of your bank account or from a cash machine
def.long: To take money out of your bank account, for example at a cash machine or at the bank counter. You withdraw money from an account.

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash.
examples.tr: Biraz nakit para çekmem gerekiyor.

examples.en: Lucas withdrew 200 euros from the cash machine.
examples.tr: Lucas bankamatikten 200 euro çekti.

examples.en: You can withdraw up to 5,000 lira a day with this card.
examples.tr: Bu kartla günde en fazla 5.000 lira çekebilirsin.

etymology.text: From Middle English: 'with', which once meant 'back' or 'away', plus 'draw' (pull). So it first meant 'pull back'.

tr.note: Para çekme işlemine 'withdrawal' denir. Tersi, hesaba para yatırmak, 'deposit' ya da 'pay in' olur. Günlük konuşmada 'take out money' da çok kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The shop only takes cash, so I need to ______ some money from the cash machine.

def.short: the amount of money that is in your bank account now
def.long: The amount of money that is in a bank account at a certain time. You can check it in your bank app or at a cash machine.

examples.en: Let me check my balance first.
examples.tr: Önce bakiyemi kontrol edeyim.

examples.en: My balance is always low before payday.
examples.tr: Maaş gününden önce bakiyem hep düşük olur.

examples.en: Zeynep checked her balance in the app before she paid the rent.
examples.tr: Zeynep kirayı ödemeden önce uygulamadan bakiyesine baktı.

etymology.text: From Latin 'bilanx' (with two pans), through Old French 'balance', a weighing scale. The money meaning comes from comparing money in and money out.

tr.note: Bu kartta 'balance' hesaptaki paranın miktarıdır. Kelimenin bir de 'denge' anlamı vardır: 'lose your balance' dengeni kaybetmek demektir.

quiz.cloze: The bank app says my ______ is 30 euros, so I can't buy the 50-euro ticket.

def.micro: money you borrow from a bank
def.short: money that a bank gives you and you pay back later with extra money
def.long: Money that you borrow, usually from a bank, and pay back over time with extra money called interest.

examples.en: We got a loan to buy a car.
examples.tr: Araba almak için kredi çektik.

examples.en: Burak took out a loan for his new shop.
examples.tr: Burak yeni dükkânı için kredi çekti.

examples.en: The bank gave them a loan, and they pay 500 euros back every month.
examples.tr: Banka onlara kredi verdi; her ay 500 euro geri ödüyorlar.

etymology.text: From Old Norse 'lán'. It is related to the English verb 'lend'.

tr.note: Kredi kartı 'credit card' olur ama bankadan çekilen kredi 'loan' olur. 'Kredi çekmek' için 'take out a loan' ya da 'get a loan' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I took a credit from the bank.
mistakes.right: I took out a loan from the bank.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'kredi çekmek' denir, bu yüzden 'credit' kullanılıyor. İngilizcede bankadan çekilen belli bir para 'a loan' olur; 'credit' borçla alma düzenini anlatır: 'buy on credit', 'credit card'.

quiz.cloze: They couldn't pay for the house in cash, so they got a ______ from the bank.

def.short: need to give someone money because you borrowed it or got something from them
def.long: To need to give money to someone because they lent it to you, or because you got something and have not paid for it yet.

grammar.pattern: owe sb sth; owe sth to sb

examples.en: I owe you 200 lira for lunch.
examples.tr: Öğle yemeği için sana 200 lira borçluyum.

examples.en: How much do I owe you?
examples.tr: Sana ne kadar borçluyum?

examples.en: Sara still owes her friend 300 euros for the plane ticket.
examples.tr: Sara uçak bileti için arkadaşına hâlâ 300 euro borçlu.

etymology.text: From Old English 'āgan', meaning 'to have'. The words 'own' and 'ought' come from the same old word.

tr.note: 'I owe you 200 lira' = 'Sana 200 lira borçluyum'. Teşekkür ederken söylenen 'I owe you one' deyimi ise para değil, iyilik borcunu anlatır.

quiz.cloze: You paid for my coffee yesterday, so I ______ you 3 euros.

def.short: keep money over a period of time so you can buy something big later
def.long: To keep some of your money over weeks or months so that you can pay for something big later, like a car or a trip.

grammar.pattern: save up (for sth); save up sth

examples.en: We're saving up for a holiday in Italy.
examples.tr: İtalya tatili için para biriktiriyoruz.

examples.en: Nina saved up for two years to travel to Japan.
examples.tr: Nina Japonya'ya gitmek için iki yıl para biriktirdi.

examples.en: If we save up 200 euros a month, we can buy a car next year.
examples.tr: Ayda 200 euro biriktirirsek seneye araba alabiliriz.

tr.note: 'Save' tek başına da para biriktirmek demektir. 'Save up' ise belli bir hedef için bir süre boyunca biriktirmeyi vurgular. Hedef 'for' ile söylenir: 'save up for a car'.

quiz.cloze: Kemal wants a new laptop, so he is ______ for it every month.

def.short: give back all the money you borrowed, so you have no more debt
def.long: To give back all the money that you borrowed, so that you have no more debt. People often do this in small amounts over many months.

grammar.pattern: pay off sth; pay sth off

examples.en: I finally paid off my credit card.
examples.tr: Sonunda kredi kartı borcumu tamamen ödedim.

examples.en: It took Murat five years to pay off his car loan.
examples.tr: Murat'ın araba kredisini ödeyip bitirmesi beş yıl sürdü.

examples.en: Once we pay off the house, we will have more money for holidays.
examples.tr: Evin borcunu ödeyip bitirince tatiller için daha çok paramız olacak.

tr.note: 'Pay back' birinden aldığın parayı ona geri vermektir. 'Pay off' ise bir borcu, çoğu zaman bankaya olan bir borcu, sonuna kadar ödeyip bitirmektir: 'pay off a loan'.

quiz.cloze: After ten years, Ana finally ______ all her student loans.

def.short: having no money or very little money, usually for a short time
def.long: Having no money, or very little money, usually for a short time. It is an informal word that people use with friends and family.

examples.en: I can't come to the cinema. I'm broke.
examples.tr: Sinemaya gelemem. Beş parasızım.

examples.en: Yusuf is always broke at the end of the month.
examples.tr: Yusuf ay sonunda hep meteliksiz kalıyor.

examples.en: After paying for the holiday, Hana was completely broke for weeks.
examples.tr: Tatilin parasını ödedikten sonra Hana haftalarca tamamen meteliksiz kaldı.

tr.note: Burada 'broke' bir sıfattır, 'break' fiilinin geçmiş zamanı değildir: 'I'm broke' 'Meteliksizim' demektir, 'kırıldım' değil. Gayriresmîdir.

quiz.cloze: I spent all my money on the trip, so I'm ______ until payday.

entries.sense_note: must be paid by a date

def.micro: to be paid on a certain day
def.short: needing to be paid on or before a certain date
def.long: Needing to be paid on or before a certain date. If you pay after that day, your payment is late.

examples.en: The rent is due on Friday.
examples.tr: Kiranın son ödeme günü cuma.

examples.en: When is the phone bill due?
examples.tr: Telefon faturasının son ödeme tarihi ne zaman?

examples.en: The first payment is due at the end of March, so Emma is saving every week.
examples.tr: İlk ödemenin mart sonunda yapılması gerekiyor, bu yüzden Emma her hafta para biriktiriyor.

etymology.text: From Old French 'deü', meaning 'owed', from Latin 'debere' (to owe). The word 'debt' comes from the same Latin word.

tr.note: 'Due date' son ödeme tarihidir. Gün ya da tarih 'on' ile söylenir: 'due on Friday'. 'En geç' demek için 'by' kullanılır: 'due by the 10th'.

quiz.cloze: Pay the electricity bill today. It's ______ tomorrow, and you don't want to be late.

def.short: a small amount of money that parents give their children every week or month
def.long: A small amount of money that parents give their children regularly, often every week, to spend on small things.

examples.en: My parents gave me pocket money every week.
examples.tr: Annemle babam bana her hafta harçlık verirdi.

examples.en: Leo spends his pocket money on comics.
examples.tr: Leo harçlığını çizgi romanlara harcıyor.

examples.en: Selin saves half of her pocket money to buy a new game.
examples.tr: Selin yeni bir oyun almak için harçlığının yarısını biriktiriyor.

tr.note: Amerikan İngilizcesinde buna 'allowance' denir: 'My parents give me an allowance.'

quiz.cloze: Arda's parents give him ______ every week, and he spends it on sweets.
